findings.q: (1) Wird T6 als ABSOLUT-Wert oder als DELTA berichtet? Wo genau wird store_allocator_statistics() in den Snapshot gelesen, und passiert das nach rollback_all + measure-op?
findings.a: ABSOLUT (kumulativ), kein Delta. T6 wird in fill_observer_v3 gelesen: abi_adapter.hpp:1150 `auto const a = container_algorithm_.store_allocator_statistics();` und danach ROH, ohne jede Baseline-Subtraktion, in r[0..5] geschrieben (abi_adapter.hpp:1160-1167: r[0]=a.total_bytes_allocated ...). Der bevorzugte 5-Feld-Zweig (:1152-1168) ist der axis_06-Snapshot; der Fallback (:1169-1177, a.bytes_allocated/alloc_calls) ist der heutige Store. fill_observer_v3 laeuft aus tier_observe(&snap.observer), und tier_observe wird pro Checkpoint EINMAL am ENDE aufgerufen: tier_observe_trace_abi.hpp:268 — d.h. NACH der gesamten Write-/Read-/Delete-Phase, also nach dem letzten rollback_all + der letzten (nicht zurueckgerollten) measure-op. In two_phase_measure (tier_observe_trace_abi.hpp:110-118) ist genau die MESS-op der einzige logische Fortschritt (save->warmup->rollback_all->measure, measure NICHT zurueckgerollt). Die Store-Zaehler selbst sind monoton (tree_node_pool_store.hpp:134-139 record_capacity_growth_ nur ++/+=, keine per-op-Ruecksetzung); reset_axis_statistics_ (abi_adapter.hpp:1930-1952) nullt sie NICHT (ruft nur container_algorithm_.reset(), das den Observer-POD stats_ leert, nicht die Alloc-Member). => T6 = absoluter kumulierter Wert seit Store-Konstruktion/letztem clear().
findings.evidence: abi_adapter.hpp:1148-1177 (Roh-Read + Direkt-Assign, keine Delta-Bildung); tier_observe_trace_abi.hpp:268 (tier_observe am Phasen-Ende) + :110-118 (measure-op nicht zurueckgerollt); tree_node_pool_store.hpp:134-139 (monotone Akkumulation), :73-79 (Snapshot-Getter); abi_adapter.hpp:1930-1952 (reset_axis_statistics_ ruehrt Alloc-Member nicht an)

findings.q: (2) Werden die Allocator-Stats beim rollback (container_algorithm_=*saved) mit-zurueckgesetzt, oder separat via restore_statistics (das nur den OBSERVER-POD stats_ betrifft)?
findings.a: Sie werden AUSSCHLIESSLICH als Beifang der Daten-Copy-Assign zurueckgesetzt, NICHT ueber restore_statistics. Zwei getrennte Mechanismen in tier_rollback_all (CoW-Pfad): (a) abi_adapter.hpp:1755 `container_algorithm_ = *saved_container_algorithm_` — copy-ASSIGN des GANZEN ObservableComposedContainer inkl. innerem container_ (=ComposedTreeSearch->pool_->TreeNodePoolStore mit den by-value-Membern alloc_calls_/bytes_allocated_/live_nodes_, tree_node_pool_store.hpp:151-153). Beim heutigen Plain-Member-Store setzt dieser Assign die Alloc-Stats also mit zurueck. (b) abi_adapter.hpp:1768 `container_algorithm_.restore_statistics(saved_container_algorithm_stats_)` — betrifft laut observable_composed_container.hpp:130 NUR stats_ (SearchAlgoStatistics-Observer-POD), NICHT die Alloc-Member. Kritische Asymmetrie: der Daten-Assign (:1755) laeuft nur unter `if (cow_materialized_)` (:1754) — bei READ-only-Warmup (lookup, cow_materialized_ bleibt false) wird container_algorithm_ NICHT restauriert; nur restore_statistics laeuft. Fuer Lookups unschaedlich (allozieren nichts), aber es zeigt: es gibt KEINEN dedizierten Alloc-Stats-Kanal. saved_container_algorithm_stats_ traegt nur SearchAlgoStatistics (abi_adapter.hpp:1733 = statistics(), Typ via OrganStatsSnap=decltype(statistics()) :2167 = observable_composed_container.hpp:123 snapshot_t=SearchAlgoStatistics) — die AllocationStatistics ist dort NICHT enthalten.
findings.evidence: abi_adapter.hpp:1754-1755 (Daten-Assign nur bei cow_materialized_), :1768 (restore_statistics=nur Observer-POD), :1733 + :2167 (saved_container_algorithm_stats_ = SearchAlgoStatistics); observable_composed_container.hpp:123/125/130 (snapshot_t=SearchAlgoStatistics; restore_statistics setzt nur stats_); observable_composed_container.hpp:136 (container_ als by-value-Member -> im Vollkopie enthalten); tree_node_pool_store.hpp:151-153 (Alloc-Member)

findings.q: (3) Pflanzt sich Strategie-Stats-Pollution einer strategie-besitzenden Store bei COW-Kopie in den GEMESSENEN T6-Wert fort, oder wird sie neutralisiert? Exakter Pfad.
findings.a: HEUTE neutralisiert (keine Pollution), im GEPLANTEN strategie-besitzenden Store aber PROPAGIERT sie in T6. Heute: TreeNodePoolStore nutzt A=std::allocator (stateless, tree_node_pool_store.hpp:40/128) und zaehlt NUR an den expliziten Call-Sites record_capacity_growth_ in allocate_node/free_node (:97/:110), NICHT im Allocator. cow_materialize_copy_ (abi_adapter.hpp:2176 saved_container_algorithm_.emplace(container_algorithm_)) und der Rollback-Assign (:1755) kopieren die Alloc-Member by-value ueber den vector-Copy-Ctor, der record_capacity_growth_ NIE aufruft => keine Doppelzaehlung. Warmup-Insert-Wachstum wird durch den Rollback-Assign (:1755) rueckgaengig gemacht; nur die Mess-op zaehlt => sauber. GEPLANT (Hebel B, strategie-besitzende Store, StdAllocatorAdapter haelt Derived*, Stats leben in der Strategie): (i) Warmup-Write -> cow_materialize_copy_ macht Copy (Copy-Ctor realloziert die Vektoren DURCH die Strategie -> Strategie-Stats zaehlen die COW-Kopie mit); (ii) rollback_all mit cow_materialized_=true -> :1755 copy-ASSIGN aus der bereits polluteten Kopie zurueck, wobei der Assign SELBST erneut ueber die Strategie realloziert; (iii) restore_statistics (:1768) fasst die Alloc-Stats NICHT an (nur Observer-POD); (iv) es gibt keine Delta-/Baseline-Subtraktion (T6 absolut, :1160). Danach measure-op + tier_observe (:268) liest store_allocator_statistics -> die polluteten Strategie-Stats fliessen 1:1 in r[0..4]. Genau der revertierte 0.3a-Befund (naiver rebindender Copy-Ctor -> COW-Kopie alloziert erneut -> Doppelzaehlung). Neutralisierung faende NUR statt, wenn (a) T6 als Delta gebildet, oder (b) die Alloc-Stats einen eigenen Save/Restore-Memento-Kanal haetten, oder (c) Copy/Assign die Strategie-Stats by-value uebernaehmen OHNE strategie-gezaehlte Reallokation — nichts davon existiert heute.
findings.evidence: tree_node_pool_store.hpp:40/128 (A=std::allocator stateless), :97/:110/:134-139 (Zaehlung nur an record_capacity_growth_-Call-Sites, nicht im Allocator); abi_adapter.hpp:2176 (cow_materialize_copy_ Copy) + :1755 (Rollback copy-Assign) + :1768 (restore_statistics deckt Alloc nicht) + :1160-1167 (absoluter Roh-Read); tier_observe_trace_abi.hpp:268 (Read nach measure-op)

findings.q: (4) Genuegt fuer cow_capable_ korrekte Copy/Assign + bestehendes restore_statistics (Observer-POD), oder braucht die Allocator-Stats einen EIGENEN Save/Restore-Kanal?
findings.a: Fuer den HEUTIGEN Plain-Member-Store genuegt es; fuer den GEPLANTEN strategie-besitzenden Store (Hebel B) NICHT — die Allocator-Stats brauchen einen EIGENEN Save/Restore-Kanal. cow_capable_ (abi_adapter.hpp:2155-2157) = organ_cow_capable_v (requires s.restore_statistics(cs.statistics()), :2154) && is_copy_constructible && is_copy_assignable. Dieses Gate ist rein compile-time und pruefbar durch jeden Store mit Copy/Assign + Observer-POD-restore_statistics; es sagt NICHTS ueber die Allocator-Stats-Korrektheit. Grund: der einzige gesicherte POD ist saved_container_algorithm_stats_ = statistics() (:1733), Typ = decltype(statistics()) = SearchAlgoStatistics (observable_composed_container.hpp:123) — die AllocationStatistics ist NICHT enthalten und hat keinen Save/Restore-Pfad. Beim Plain-Store reitet sie by-value in der Store-Vollkopie mit (kein Strategie-Realloc) -> korrekt. Beim strategie-besitzenden Store re-polluteren gerade cow_materialize_copy_ (:2176) UND der Rollback-Assign (:1755) die Strategie-Stats, und restore_statistics (:1768) korrigiert sie nicht. Erforderlich waere daher: ein Memento-POD analog saved_container_algorithm_stats_, der in tier_save_all die AllocationStatistics (store_allocator_statistics()) snapshotet und in tier_rollback_all ueber einen eigenen restore_allocator_statistics-Kanal zurueckschreibt — UND/ODER Copy-Ctor/Assign, die den Strategie-Stat-POD by-value uebernehmen und die strukturelle Kopie NICHT ueber die zaehlende Strategie allozieren lassen. Ohne das re-polluteret der Rollback-Assign selbst.
findings.evidence: abi_adapter.hpp:2154-2157 (cow_capable_ / organ_cow_capable_v pruefen nur Observer-POD-restore + copyability), :1733 + :2185-2186 (saved_container_algorithm_stats_ = OrganStatsSnap = decltype(statistics()) = SearchAlgoStatistics), :2176 + :1755 (Copy + Assign re-allozieren im strategie-Fall), :1768 (restore_statistics nur Observer-POD); observable_composed_container.hpp:117-121 (store_allocator_statistics eigener Getter, ohne korrespondierenden restore)

findings.q: Where does stats_ live in axis_06? Does the base have reset()/restore?
findings.a: stats_ lives PER-DERIVED, not in the base. AllocatorStrategyBase (axis_06_allocator_strategy_base.hpp) is intentionally STATELESS (EBO-preserving, holds no data member) and only CRTP-delegates statistics()/reset() to Derived (lines 103-110). It has NO restore_statistics(). Each concrete family owns `concepts::AllocationStatistics stats_{}` + an observer_ (ExgenAllocator: axis_06_allocator_exgen.hpp:180-181; statistics() returns stats_ :115; reset() sets stats_={} :117-120). So any allocator-side restore must be added per family, mirroring the existing reset() delegate — there is no base member to hang it on without breaking EBO.
findings.evidence: axis_06_allocator_strategy_base.hpp:59-110 (base derives AxisBase+CacheLineAware, delegates statistics()/reset(), no stats_ member, no restore); axis_06_allocator_exgen.hpp:112-123,178-182 (stats_ + observer_ in Derived; reset() but no restore_statistics)

findings.q: Option A (Store owns strategy + copy-ctor that restores source stats via new strategy.restore_statistics()) — is it COW-correct and where does stats_ live / how much surface?
findings.a: VIABLE and the ONLY fully COW-correct option that leaves abi_adapter untouched. Because the strategy (with its stats_) lives INSIDE the store INSIDE container_algorithm_t, it is copied by cow_materialize_copy_ (:2176) and rolled back by copy-assign in tier_rollback_all (:1755). The custom store copy-ctor AND copy-assign must both reallocate the vectors THEN call strategy_.restore_statistics(src.strategy_.statistics()) to discard the copy-time reallocation pollution — this is a textbook Memento (snapshot=statistics(), restore=restore_statistics). Trace: materialize -> saved.strategy.stats == save-stand; warmup grows live; rollback (live=*saved) reallocates+restores live.strategy.stats := saved == save-stand; measure op adds ONLY its own real allocation delta -> T6 = save-stand + measure-delta, pollution-free. stats_ stays in the axis_06 Derived (status-quo location). Surface: NOT just the base — a base CRTP-delegate restore_statistics() (~4 lines, mirrors reset()) PLUS a per-family `void restore_statistics(snapshot_t const& s){stats_=s;}` in each reachable axis_06 family (~17, mirroring the 17 restore_statistics already present on the search-algo organs), plus optional concept extension, plus the store rewrite (owned strategy driving node_/free_ vectors via StdAllocatorAdapter, custom copy-ctor+copy-assign). No abi_adapter/ABI/golden/POD touch: T6 route already PREFERS the 5-field branch and will auto-switch once store_allocator_statistics() returns strategy.statistics().
findings.evidence: abi_adapter.hpp:2154-2157 (cow_capable_ = restore_statistics(statistics()) && copy_ctor && copy_assign), :2176 (emplace copy), :1755 (copy-assign back), :1768 (restore_statistics called); T6 preferred 5-field branch abi_adapter.hpp:288-298 & 1152-1168; the 17 search-algo restore_statistics precedent (grep) show the pattern; reset() delegate precedent axis_06_allocator_strategy_base.hpp:106-109

findings.q: Option B (Store owns strategy for real alloc, keeps T6 stats as plain-member snapshot updated per-op via allocator_.statistics()) — does the measure-op reading the rollback-polluted live strategy actually solve pollution?
findings.a: NO — B as literally specified (absolute assign `stats_snapshot_ = allocator_.statistics()` after each op) does NOT solve pollution. The plain-member snapshot is correctly rolled back BY VALUE at copy (like today's uint64 members), but the underlying live strategy's ABSOLUTE counters are never rolled back (no restore_statistics), and they accumulate ALL churn: initial fill + warmup op + the full-vector reallocation of every cow_materialize copy-ctor and every rollback copy-assign, across every fill_segment iteration. The MEASURE op then executes `stats_snapshot_ = allocator_.statistics()` which OVERWRITES the freshly-rolled-back snapshot with the polluted absolute live counter (save-stand + all accumulated garbage), not (save-stand + measure-delta). So B relocates the 0.3a garbage from copy-time to the post-op absolute read — same failure. It could only be rescued by a DELTA accumulator (snapshot += statistics()-before_op), which is pollution-immune BUT no longer faithfully equals the axis_06 5-field snapshot (total_bytes_in_use is net/non-monotonic, failure_count etc.) — a fragile reconstruction, not the real strategy snapshot. Verdict: non-viable for Hebel-B's goal (T6 == chosen-strategy real statistics) unless degraded to the delta variant with caveats.
findings.evidence: abi_adapter.hpp:2176 (materialize copy reallocates) + :1755 (rollback copy-assign reallocates) both hit the strategy each iteration; no restore of strategy stats in tier_rollback_all for the plain-member path; today's plain uint64 members (tree_node_pool_store.hpp:150-154, record_capacity_growth_:134-139) are pollution-free ONLY because they are allocator-INDEPENDENT vector-capacity counters, never re-read from a live strategy

findings.q: Option C (Tier-level: anatomy owns ONE strategy, pool vectors threaded onto EXTERNAL strategy via adapter; ctor-threading through ComposedTreeSearch) — how to COW-copy when adapter points to shared external, and surface/ABI proximity?
findings.a: VIABLE in principle but the DIRTIEST and closest to the ABI/golden tabu. The store holds only a StdAllocatorAdapter (a Derived* to the anatomy-level shared strategy); copying the store copies the POINTER shallowly (is_copy_constructible holds, so cow_capable_ is satisfiable — good), and both live and COW-copy allocate via the SAME external strategy. BUT the strategy now lives OUTSIDE container_algorithm_t, so the existing COW save/rollback does NOT snapshot/restore it — restore_statistics on container_algorithm_ cannot reach it. Correctness therefore REQUIRES adding a strategy member to the anatomy AND adding its save/restore into tier_save_all/tier_rollback_all in abi_adapter (which still needs restore_statistics on the strategy too). Plus: ctor-threading a strategy pointer down through ComposedTreeSearch and the pool store collides with ObservableComposedContainer's default-constructed `Container container_{}` (:136) — needs a post-construction rebind, and the stateful adapter pointer risks dangling across anatomy copy/move. Surface: pool store ctor + every composable layer's ctor + anatomy member + abi_adapter two-phase machinery (:1709/:1749). That is the largest structural surface and touches the ABI-sensitive abi_adapter/anatomy — worst on the 'no ABI/golden touch' constraint.
findings.evidence: ComposedStore precedent (axis_04_node_type_composed_store.hpp:126-138) shows exactly this adapter-holds-&allocator_ Derived* pattern AND its deleted Copy/Move because 'korrekte Rematerialisierung am Ziel-allocator_ ist Folge-Increment'; ObservableComposedContainer default-ctor container_{} :136; tier two-phase entry points abi_adapter.hpp:1709,1749

result.chosen_option: Option A — Store-owned axis_06-Strategie (Default `ExgenAllocator`) mit benutzerdefiniertem Copy-Ctor + Copy-Assign, die die Vektoren ueber die eigene Strategie re-allozieren UND danach per Memento (`allocator_.restore_statistics(src.allocator_.statistics())`) die COW-Kopier-Pollution verwerfen. abi_adapter/Anatomie bleiben UNBERUEHRT (im Gegensatz zu Option C = Tier-Level-Besitz, GO-pflichtig). Option B (Plain-Member-Snapshot per absolutem Post-Op-Read) ist als geschrieben nachweislich NICHT COW-korrekt — verschiebt die 0.3a-Pollution nur vom Copy-Zeitpunkt in den absoluten Post-Op-Read. Muster: Memento (GoF), auf der bestehenden statistics()/restore_statistics-CRTP-Achse; loest exakt die im DOSSIER 3b (COW-Wand) dokumentierte Doppelzaehlung.
result.rationale: Der Pool-Store lebt IM COW-kopierten Such-Organ (container_algorithm_t): cow_materialize_copy_ (abi_adapter.hpp:2176 `saved_container_algorithm_.emplace(container_algorithm_)`) kopiert ihn, tier_rollback_all (:1755 copy-ASSIGN zurueck) restauriert ihn. Der 0.3a-Bruch war doppelt: (i) axis_04-Muster loescht Copy/Move -> `emplace` unkonstruierbar -> Bau bricht; (ii) naiver rebindender Copy-Ctor alloziert erneut ueber die mitkopierte Strategie -> Stats-Doppelzaehlung -> T6 korrumpiert. Option A behebt BEIDES: Copy/Assign existieren (cow_capable_ bleibt erfuellt) UND ein Memento-restore verwirft die durch die strukturelle Re-Allokation entstandene Pollution am Ende jeder Kopie/jedes Rollbacks. Ein eigener Save/Restore-Kanal in abi_adapter ist NICHT noetig, weil die Strategie-Stats mit dem Store by-value durch cow_materialize/rollback reisen und die Neutralisierung lokal im Store-Copy stattfindet — daher ABI-/Anatomie-frei. cow_capable_ (abi_adapter.hpp:2154-2157) prueft restore_statistics auf dem CONTAINER (ObservableComposedContainer, observable_composed_container.hpp:130 — unberuehrt, SearchAlgoStatistics-Kanal) plus is_copy_constructible/assignable des container_algorithm_t; user-definierte Store-Copy/Assign halten beide true. Die T6-Route bevorzugt bereits den 5-Feld-Zweig (abi_adapter.hpp:1152-1160: r[0]=total_bytes_allocated, r[1]=total_bytes_in_use, r[2]=allocation_count ...) und schaltet automatisch um, sobald store_allocator_statistics() `AllocationStatistics` liefert. restore_statistics wird NICHT in ein Concept gehoben (bleibt requires-detektiert/opt-in) -> Surface auf Exgen (die einzige vom BST-Slice erreichte Familie) + einen CRTP-Basis-Delegate begrenzt, golden-320-neutral.

result.cow_correctness: T6 wird ABSOLUT (kumulativ, keine Delta-Bildung) am Phasen-Ende gelesen (tier_observe nach der nicht-zurueckgerollten measure-op). Korrektheit haengt daher daran, dass die Strategie-Stats nach jedem COW-Schritt exakt den save-Stand tragen. Ablauf mit Option A: (1) cow_materialize_copy_ (abi_adapter.hpp:2176) ruft den Store-Copy-Ctor -> Vektoren werden ueber THIS-allocator_ re-alloziert (stats_ transient poll.) -> `restore_statistics(src.statistics())` setzt saved.allocator_.stats := save-Stand. (2) Warmup-Insert waechst LIVE (echte Allokationen ueber live-allocator_). (3) tier_rollback_all bei cow_materialized_ (abi_adapter.hpp:1755) copy-ASSIGNt aus saved zurueck -> Store-Copy-Assign re-alloziert ueber live-allocator_ (transiente Pollution) -> `restore_statistics(saved.statistics())` setzt live.allocator_.stats := save-Stand. (4) measure-op addiert AUSSCHLIESSLICH ihr eigenes echtes Allokations-Delta. Ergebnis: T6 = save-Stand + measure-Delta, pollutionsfrei — GENAU die im Research (Frage 3/Option A) und DOSSIER 3b geforderte Neutralisierung. Der Memento-Kanal (snapshot=statistics(), restore=restore_statistics) ist der Store-Strategie eigen und getrennt vom Container-Observer-POD-Kanal (observable_composed_container.hpp:130, SearchAlgoStatistics), der weiter via restore_statistics (abi_adapter.hpp:1768) laeuft. Kein Delta-/Baseline-Kunstgriff, kein separater abi_adapter-Save/Restore noetig. Move degradiert zu Copy -> jede Store-Relokation rebindet den Adapter auf &allocator_ (kein dangling) und restauriert die Stats.
result.boundary_compliance: golden_fullpilot_320 / permutation_axes.xml / POD sizeof==1416 (ComdareTierObserverSnapshot) / GenusBindingTraits / ABI-MAJOR==4 / Registry-mp_list: BYTE-UNBERUEHRT. Aenderung liegt ausschliesslich im Store-Body (tree_node_pool_store.hpp), einem CRTP-Basis-Delegate + einer Per-Family-Methode (Exgen) und dem s7_1-Contract-Test — KEIN abi_adapter/Anatomie/Registry/POD-Touch (die Pool-Organe sind laut IST-Verifikation KEINE mp_list-Blaetter, sondern via organ_for_search_algo-Trait erreicht -> reine Instanziierung/Store-Body, kein Registry-Templatizing). cow_capable_/organ_cow_capable_v (abi_adapter.hpp:2154-2157) bleiben unveraendert und golden-neutral, weil sie restore_statistics auf dem CONTAINER (nicht der Strategie) proben; die Store-Copy/Assign halten is_copy_constructible/assignable des container_algorithm_t erfuellt. compile-time-strikt: `requires AllocatorStrategy<Alloc>` + erhaltenes `static_assert(TreeNodePool<TreeNodePoolStore<>>)`; kein Runtime-Switch/vtable im Hot-Path. restore_statistics wird NICHT in ein Concept gehoben (opt-in, requires-detektiert) -> Surface auf Exgen begrenzt. Default Exgen(real=std) = verhaltens-neutral. Benanntes Muster: Memento (GoF) auf bestehender statistics()/restore_statistics-CRTP-Achse.
risks: StdAllocatorAdapter (axis_06_allocator_strategy_base.hpp:126-143) haelt Derived* auf &allocator_ — jede Store-Relokation MUSS den Adapter neu binden. Copy-Ctor/Assign tun das via `node_alloc{&allocator_}`; da Move nicht deklariert wird, degradiert es sicher zu Copy. Falls irgendein Pfad in ComposedTreeSearch echten Move erwartet: mit Copy-Fallback korrekt, nur minimal langsamer (nicht Hot-Path).

allocator_traits-POCCA/POCMA-Default = false: vector-Copy-Assign behaelt THIS-allocator_ (gewuenscht). Verifizieren, dass StdAllocatorAdapter keine abweichenden propagate_-Typedefs setzt (Read bestaetigt: keine) — sonst wuerde der Assign den Quell-Adapter adoptieren und auf fremdes allocator_ zeigen.

Exgen zaehlt echte vector-Reallokationen statt der alten record_capacity_growth_-Kapazitaets-Deltas: DirectPoolStatsAreReal (>0) bleibt erfuellt, aber die absoluten Werte AENDERN SICH (dokumentierter Contract-Wechsel s7_1) — Downstream-Fixtures/CSV, die konkrete alloc_calls-Werte erwarten, pruefen.

restore_statistics als reine Methode (kein Concept-Zwang) ist opt-in: bei Ausrollen auf die uebrigen 9 Stores/Familien (Folge-Slices) muss jede erreichte Familie die Methode tragen, sonst Compile-Fehler im Store-Copy — bewusst als kleines AllocatorMemento-Concept nachziehen, NICHT in diesem BST-Slice.

total_bytes_in_use ist netto/nicht-monoton (deallocate reduziert): fuer T6-Absolutwert unkritisch (measure-op-Delta additiv), aber bei wiederholtem Copy-Assign in einer fill_segment-Timing-Schleife auf Second-Order-Drift der in_use-Konsistenz achten (Research offene Frage) — Memento-restore auf src.statistics() haelt es konsistent, da saved.data == save-Stand.

0.3a-Scope-Grenze strikt einhalten: dieser Slice aendert nur die T6-QUELLE (Default fix exgen), NOCH KEINE Cross-Allocator-Differenzierung. Das Composition-Threading (organ_for_search_algo<S> -> <S,Alloc>, Anatomie reicht permutierten axis_06-Slot) ist 0.3b, naeher an der ABI-Grenze, eigener GO-pflichtiger Increment.

issues.issue: Build-safety gap in the change surface: the store copy-ctor/copy-assign bodies call allocator_.restore_statistics(o.allocator_.statistics()) UNCONDITIONALLY, but on ExgenAllocator both statistics() and the proposed restore_statistics exist only under COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_STATISTICS (exgen :112-123). Because TreeNodePoolStore is a class template, the copy ops are only instantiated on odr-use, but the golden-320 matrix includes stats-OFF configs; any stats-off build that instantiates a store copy (COW is behind COMDARE_MEASUREMENT_ON, yet the container/tier value-semantics or tests may still copy) would fail to compile. The call MUST be wrapped in #ifdef COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_STATISTICS. This does NOT falsify T6 (measurement correctness holds) but the plan is incomplete as written.

Test/measurement exactness is weakened: the change surface remaps the s7_1 'live_nodes == keys.size()' assertion (an exact node-count invariant) to 'total_bytes_in_use > 0'. total_bytes_in_use is non-monotonic (deallocate/erase reduces it, exgen :101-104), so it no longer pins occupancy. DirectPoolStatsAreReal is insert-only so >0 passes, but prefer asserting against organ.occupied_count() to preserve the exact-count contract rather than a loose >0.

Absolute T6 values change semantics: exgen counts real vector reallocations (allocate/deallocate calls) instead of the old record_capacity_growth_ capacity-delta bookkeeping, so concrete alloc_calls/bytes numbers shift. golden_fullpilot_320 (binary/composition IDs) and the POD/ABI layout stay byte-neutral, but any recorded measurement fixture or CSV golden that pins concrete T6 magnitudes would break. Must grep downstream fixtures before landing (self-flagged risk #3).

copy-assign performs allocator_ = o.allocator_ which redundantly copies the ExgenAllocator observer_ member (MeasurableObserver) before the vectors are reassigned. Benign — notify is dead in the pull-transport hot path and the AllocatorStrategy concept requires std::copy_constructible<A> (concept :86, static_asserted for ExgenAllocator :188) so copyability is guaranteed — but the assignment of allocator_ is functionally unnecessary since restore_statistics overwrites stats_ at the end; could drop it to just restore_statistics for clarity.

COMPILE BREAK in statistics-OFF build. The proposed copy-ctor and copy-assign call `allocator_.restore_statistics(o.allocator_.statistics())` UNGUARDED in the body. Both `statistics()` and `restore_statistics()` exist ONLY inside `#ifdef COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_STATISTICS` on ExgenAllocator (axis_06_allocator_exgen.hpp:112-123) and the CRTP base (axis_06_allocator_strategy_base.hpp:103-110). Statistics-OFF is a first-class supported config: CMakeLists.txt:121 FORCEs `COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_STATISTICS=OFF` when `COMDARE_MEASUREMENT_MODE=OFF` (109 guard sites in libs/). The store copy-ctor is UNCONDITIONALLY odr-used, because `cow_materialize_copy_()` (abi_adapter.hpp:2173) calls `saved_container_algorithm_.emplace(container_algorithm_)` and is reached via a runtime `if (cow_armed_)` branch (abi_adapter.hpp:839/969/979/1909), so it is instantiated even when cow_capable_ is false. Result: in a MEASUREMENT_MODE=OFF build the copy-ctor body references nonexistent methods → hard compile error. The store currently compiles cleanly in BOTH modes (all stat members #ifdef'd); the change surface as literally written regresses that. FIX: wrap ONLY the `restore_statistics(statistics())` lines in copy-ctor/copy-assign under `#ifdef COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_STATISTICS` (or `if constexpr (requires{ allocator_.restore_statistics(o.allocator_.statistics()); })`); keep the `nodes_(o.nodes_, node_alloc{&allocator_})` adapter-rebinding unconditional in all builds.

The core justification for choosing Option A over B — neutralizing COW double-counting so T6 = save-Stand + measure-Delta — has ZERO test coverage. The two provided s7_1 tests do NOT exercise the two-phase COW path: `DirectPoolStatsAreReal` uses a bare hull (no save/rollback), and `AbiObserverRoutesPoolAllocatorStatsToT6` only calls `drv->tier_insert(...)` then `tier_observe` without ever calling `tier_save_all`/`tier_rollback_all`, so `cow_armed_` stays false and `cow_materialize_copy_`/the copy-ctor pollution path never runs at runtime. The reverted 0.3a bug was EXACTLY this double-counting. A regression test that drives save_all → warmup-insert → rollback_all → measure-op and asserts T6 equals the pollution-free expected value is required to prove the memento actually works; without it the entire Option-A-vs-B distinction is unverified.

Golden/permutation boundary neutrality is ASSERTED but not verifiable from the proposal. Changing the store's default template arg from `std::allocator<Node>` to `ExgenAllocator` changes the mangled type identity of `container_algorithm_t` for every BST-backed binary. The proposal claims golden_fullpilot_320_binary_ids.txt / permutation_axes.xml are byte-untouched (plausible: TreeNodePoolStore is not referenced in builder/compositions and is reached via the organ_for_search_algo trait, not an mp_list leaf), but provides no verification step. Because this is an explicit TABU boundary, landing requires an actual rebuild + diff of the 320 binary-ID list to confirm no ID/permutation drift before merge.

DirectPoolStatsAreReal loses coverage: line 90 currently asserts the exact live node count `EXPECT_EQ(stats.live_nodes, keys.size())` (==8). AllocationStatistics has no node-count field, and the change surface weakens it to `total_bytes_in_use > 0`. Use the proposal's own alternative `organ.occupied_count() == keys.size()` to preserve the exact-count invariant instead of degrading to a >0 smoke check.

Under OBSERVER_PUSH builds only, the copy-ctor/copy-assign re-allocation fires `observer_.notify(polluted_stats)` during the intermediate vector copy (exgen allocate() at :86 notifies), and the proposed `restore_statistics` deliberately does NOT notify, so a subscribed callback observes a spurious polluted snapshot mid-copy. Harmless in the default (no-op observer) measurement build and for the pull-based T6 path, but should be acknowledged; consider notifying after restore or documenting that store-copy must not be observed under push.

Citation drift (not a phantom line): the test change-surface cites abi_adapter.hpp:1157-1159 for the T6 field mapping, but the actual r[0..2] assignments are at 1160-1162 (1152-1158 is the requires-detection block). The mapping (r[0]=total_bytes_allocated, r[1]=total_bytes_in_use, r[2]=allocation_count) is correct; only the line numbers are ~3 lines off.
